name: anim_jyu_walk
subject: a huge, heavy bear man made of glossy brown paint with messy cream splotches, a big round belly, a grumpy face with the mouth closed, straight thick human legs with bare human feet
desc: Walk cycle in place, keeping the same three-quarter view as the first frame for the whole cycle: the body never turns sideways, the big round belly and both broad shoulders keep the same width. A slow, heavy, lumbering walk: only the thick legs step in turn, one knee lifts a little and the foot stomps down, then the other, the thick arms swing slightly, the heavy body and belly bob 2 or 3 pixels up and down with each step, paint drips stretch and fall. The body does not move across the frame. The face keeps the same grumpy stern look with the mouth closed. Thick, sticky, viscous paint.
